title: Pro Shop Store Credit: redemption eligibility basis (retired)
content:
## Basis
This policy formerly determined redemption eligibility for a Pro Shop Store Credit account on two grounds: that store credit could be redeemed only while the account sat in active status, and that a single calendar day's redemptions could not exceed the tier's own daily redemption ceiling.

Both of these grounds are no longer in force. The current basis for whether, and how much, store credit may be redeemed toward a purchase — including how a member's standing elsewhere affects a redemption, and over what span redemption activity is measured against the tier's ceiling — is governed elsewhere.

## Points of judgement
- Neither the account-status ground nor the daily-ceiling ground stated above may be applied to a redemption request as this policy's own basis; both have been superseded.
- The tier's own daily redemption ceiling figure itself remains a valid tier parameter and continues to be referenced by the current handling basis, even though the day-window measurement stated here is no longer in force.

superseded_clauses: a single day's redemptions may not exceed redemption_daily_limit_usd
Store credit may be redeemed only while the account is active, and a single day's redemptions may not exceed redemption_daily_limit_usd
